body: It looks like your old Hibu site is gone, so there's nothing left behind that error. I can put this homepage up on larryslawns.com and clear the error, so anyone who looks you up lands on it.
Why? We're a small studio building our portfolio, and {{who_they_are}} is exactly the kind of work we want to show.
Worth a look? If not, no worries.
